decisions.reason: The ID Vault extends the firm's core digital identity know-how and fits as a feature of the super-app platform, so management can read its early results and improve it.
An identity-bound wallet builds on the firm's identity and payment expertise, but it overlaps with the payment and wallet framework and may be folded into it.
NFC tag login fits the firm's authentication knowledge base, but as a hardware-adjacent niche item it is only briefly mentioned and is at risk of quiet removal.
The secure payment and wallet framework has its own page and draws on the firm's established payment and security capabilities, giving it strong absorptive fit.
The multi-service app platform is the flagship that integrates all the firm's accumulated security and identity knowledge and defines its strategic direction.
Application shielding rests directly on decades of the firm's application-security expertise and patents, and it is presented on its own page.
